meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: Claude 会为长期目标创建持久记录,可查看或用命令更新其状态。完成前须逐项核对交付物与真实证据;确认无遗留工作才标记完成。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设定、继续或审查长期目标(暂停、恢复、完成、检查等),或已存在进行中的目标时。

say.text: 帮我创建一个目标:把 pi-goal 扩展发版,预算 50000 token
say.note: 会调用 create_goal 建持久记录
会调用 get_goal 返回记录

say.text: 把当前目标标记为完成
say.note: 会先审计证据再调用 update_goal

howto.what_en: Claude will create persistent records for long-running goals, inspect them, and update status via commands. Before marking complete, it must verify each deliverable against real evidence and only complete when no required work remains.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal, or when an active goal already exists.

say_en.text: Create a goal: ship the pi-goal extension with a 50000 token budget.
say_en.note: Calls create_goal for a persistent record.
Calls get_goal to return the record.

say_en.text: Mark the current goal as complete.
say_en.note: Audits evidence first, then calls update_goal.
